body_text: A class of 25 is organised so children can move in small groups of 5–8 between learning centres, each offering a different way to explore the same idea.
title: Child-Friendly Furniture
text: Children move freely, make choices and reach materials on their own.
text_2: Resources that invite children to question, build, imagine and create.

image.alt: Classroom learning centre with low wooden shelves, books and cushions

text_3: Tables that encourage conversation while keeping every child included.
text_4: Children revisit their work and feel proud of it.
text_5: Well-lit rooms with soft pastel tones feel warm and welcoming.
